input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there

doc_friction.issue: Chaining `cd X && ( ... ) &` puts the whole and-list in the background, so the shell's cwd did not change and the next command's relative paths failed once. That's a shell trap, not a doc error, but cloud-session.md could mention it beside the 'Long commands' advice.

--for-changes hands off after 100 s and forbids creating a new tracked file (the run record) until it finishes. GitHub CI finished green first (about 4 min), so the local run was redundant for a research-only diff. The doc could say to prefer PR check runs when runners are not starved.

deviations.why: The run record was written while run_workflow_locally.py was still running (it voids that local run).
deviations.did: Relied on the PR's GitHub check runs, all green (research homepage, test, validate, build and the rest), plus the project's 81 tests run locally.

notes: capture-sync step 6b, milestone 6. The plan and predictions were committed before the run. 120 sessions x 11 conditions took about 17 min on 4 cores; 6a's numbers reproduced to the digit. Holding the rl1 line is out of sync 0-4%, exactly rl1's coarse failure share. The one-frame gated tracker scores 0.5-5.1% and the PSR-median vote 7.0-13.6%. kr equals the vote, so the dropped rate did not matter. 4 of 7 predictions held. Local checks: pytest 81 passed, build.py ok, check_posts ok, check_md_links ok, programme_check ok, cite_check ok (some ids marked ok*). Next step (6c): sessions with rate wander.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design and code a tracker module with tests, a 17-min simulation study, and the write-up (README, log, post), as a signal-processing PhD student would

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
